decks.notes: The deck focuses on maintaining control over the game through disruption and removal spells, while also utilizing creatures like Gifted Aetherborn and Graveyard Trespasser to apply pressure. It also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to further control the board. The deck is designed to outvalue and outlast opponents by utilizing a mix of hand disruption, removal, and resilient threats. The inclusion of Mutavault and Castle Locthwain provide additional utility and card advantage to help maintain control over the game.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the key card to control the game. With a variety of lands and spells that can be fetched with Bring to Light, the deck aims to have answers to different threats through Leyline Binding, lightning helix, and removal spells like Maelstrom Pulse and Vanishing Verse. Additionally, the deck includes powerful companions like Yorion, Sky Nomad to provide extra value. Overall, the deck is designed to have a flexible game plan that can adapt to different matchups and control the game until Niv-Mizzet Reborn can take over.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and utilize various card draw and cantrip effects to maintain a high tempo and pressure on the opponent. The deck combines burn spells with disruptive counter magic to control the battlefield while continuously reanimating Arclight Phoenix to deal damage and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of various spells with flashback mechanics allows for flexibility in spell casting and graveyard manipulation to maximize the effectiveness of the deck's strategy.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize cheap and efficient spells to quickly build a board presence and pressure the opponent. It focuses on playing instants and sorceries while maintaining card advantage through draw spells like Consider and Sleight of Hand. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter and Vivi Ornitier to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of counter spells like Spell Pierce and tempo cards like Into the Flood Maw help control the game and protect your threats.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck utilizes a combination of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, along with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain control of the game while finishing off the opponent with powerful threats like Blade of the Oni and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to pressure the opponent and control the board. The key idea is to use efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes utility cards like Mutavault and Kolaghan's Command to provide additional value and flexibility in various matchups. By combining disruption and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The primary focus of this Red Deck Wins aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells. Utilizing low mana cost creatures like Screaming Nemesis and Heartfire Hero alongside powerful burn spells such as Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike, the deck looks to continuously apply pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. Den of the Bugbear and Mutavault provide additional creature threats, while cards like Soul-Scar Mage and Monstrous Rage help to enhance the damage output of the deck's creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive red creatures and direct burn spells. The key strategy revolves around deploying efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Manifold Mouse early on, backed up by direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage help to provide additional reach and ensure that the deck can close out games quickly.Overall, the deck aims to establish board presence and deliver consistent damage to secure a swift victory.

The deck's mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while utilizing cards like Mutavault and Blade of the Oni for additional damage. This aggressive red deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost creatures and burn spells, utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger and Heartfire Hero to deal damage quickly. The addition of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Reckless Rage helps to maintain board control and deal with opposing threats. The deck focuses on aggressive red creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Burst Lightning, Lightning Strike, and Reckless Rage to remove opposing threats and push through damage. The creatures in the deck, such as Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Screaming Nemesis, have powerful abilities that can overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Mutavault and Ramunap Ruins to provide additional sources of damage. This Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and disruptive spells to maintain board control and pressure opponents quickly. The deck includes cards that provide tempo advantage, such as Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, and has the ability to protect its creatures with effects like Sheltered by Ghosts. By efficiently deploying threats and using countermagic and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing a mix of hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse, and powerful creatures like Cecil, Dark Knight and Shiko, Paragon of the Way. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient and versatile threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also including utility lands like Takenuma, Abandoned Mire and Plaza of Heroes.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. Additionally, the inclusion of Mishra's Research Desk and Experimental Synthesizer allows for card advantage and extra resources to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Herald of Anguish and Rottenmouth Viper to close out games. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with constant threats and disruption.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and evasive threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Moon-Circuit Hacker. By combining efficient disruption with aggressive creatures, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board to secure a quick victory. Additionally, the deck utilizes Faerie Miscreant and Enduring Curiosity to generate card advantage and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and control the game. The deck focuses on efficient removal and disruption with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing Seasoned Hallowblade for protection. The Monument to Endurance provides additional support for the combo pieces, while Overlord of the Balemurk and Collective Brutality offer additional utility and disruption options. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence.
